[SWS_DM_00203] Check for Supported Subfunction and Reaction
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04224
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall check, whether the Subfunction ad-
dressed by the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) is supported by checking the exis-
tence of the corresponding attributes
start
or
stop
or
requestResult
in the related
DiagnosticRoutine
configuration. If the Subfunction addressed by the UDS Ser-
vice RoutineControl (0x31) is not supported by the configuration a negative response
NRC 0x12 (
kSubFunctionNotSupported
) shall be returned.
⌋
